items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: one of the contemporaries of Sidney was a gentleman in France who you played with by the name of Moustache... his name is Francois Galapedes.

ctx.x: I see. Well, one of the contemporaries of Sidney was a gentleman in France who you played with by the name of Moustache. How do you pronounce his name, his last name, Francois?
His real name -- he's a Greek but he's been in Paris for many years now. He was born there, but he's of Greek descent and his name is Francois Galapedes.
